title: FaceLookAt
description: Point the gaze. `screen`: `x`, `y` in [-1, 1] with origin at the screen centre, +x right, +y up. `head`: `yaw`, `pitch` in degrees in the head frame, +yaw left, +pitch up. `face`: follow a detected face (`faces` topic) until another `look_at`: `face_id`, or the locked (largest) face when omitted; the gaze rests when no face is seen. The world frame needs pose and arrives later.

face_id.description: `face` only: the face to follow; default the locked (largest) face.

duration_ms.description: Hold the gaze, then return to idle motion. Omit to hold until the next `look_at`.
